affected_goals.reason: The goal drops from four properties to three. Property (c) — the gateway state a copied home inherits — is REMOVED from the goal rather than left permanently unmet: a goal carrying a property nobody intends to deliver reads as failure forever, which teaches the ledger to be ignored. The remaining three (no credential travels, no bin/cli entry names the source home, the copy is usable on Linux) are unchanged and still decided by OUN-8.
